title: decision-api: schedule bounded inference batches and separate capacity lanes
body:
<!-- openagents-project-triage:start -->
## Project triage

Project: [Decision Router](https://github.com/orgs/OpenAgentsInc/projects/15) · Workstream: Classification and scale · Priority: P2 · Readiness: Ready.

Parent tracker: #9481.

Open prerequisites: none.

Landed prerequisites retained as native dependency links: #9474, #9467, #9468.

Use the landed receipt schema from #9471. Optional #9459/#9460 model optimizations are not prerequisites for bounded scheduling or the measured serial/packed comparison.

<!-- openagents-project-triage:end -->

---

Deliver measured throughput for many independent states without conflating a bulk HTTP payload with efficient model execution.

Specification: [batch execution and durable jobs](https://github.com/OpenAgentsInc/openagents/blob/main/docs/decision-models/decision-api.md#batch-execution-and-durable-jobs). Product tracker: #9481. This is planned work; the specification does not establish availability.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Separate model/checkpoint selection, interactive or bulk capacity, and review policy. A capacity choice cannot silently replace an artifact or change the question semantics.
- [ ] Implement context-aware packing and bounded backend concurrency, preserving item/question isolation, stable reconstruction, and tenant boundaries. Publish which adapters support actual batched execution.
- [ ] Bound queue size, token/option/question work, memory estimates, per-tenant concurrency, deadlines, and dedicated allocations; schedule fairly under mixed workloads.
- [ ] Split work only at declared item/question boundaries. Reject atomic work that cannot fit; never silently shorten state, labels, or instructions.
- [ ] Handle cold starts, saturation, cancellation, backend death, and partial execution with typed outcomes and Retry-After where applicable; retain attempted and unknown work for settlement.
- [ ] Measure completed decisions per second, end-to-end and per-item latency, queue time, cold/warm behavior, utilization, cost, and incomplete coverage on pinned workloads. Compare serial and packed execution without claiming amortized time as request latency.
- [ ] Test tenant isolation, reordered backend responses, cancellation races, pressure limits, and no answer interference using bounded fixtures.

## Dependencies and boundaries

Depends on #9468 admission, #9467 accounting, #9474 bindings, and #9471 receipts. Performance optimization follows measurements; existing #9459/#9460 remain conditional.
